description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PlayerAndBot" name="Player and farming bot" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SendMaterials" name="Send materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Begin"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateBot" name="Create custom farming bot"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseResources" name="Choose resources to gather"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define tool and resource dependencies"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Farming" name="Start farming"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm resources by priority and tool dependencies">
        <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
          <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">min(numberOfSelectedResources, 10)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
        </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Farming" name="Farming finished"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Disaster" name="Handle natural disaster" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">naturalDisasterStrikes</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply setback to bot"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Disaster" name="Setback applied"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Start_Task" sourceRef="StartEvent_Disaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Task_End" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="EndEvent_Disaster"/>
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Disaster">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Disaster_Bot" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify player of milestone" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">milestoneReached</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Milestone" name="Player notified"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Start_Task" sourceRef="StartEvent_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Task_End" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_Milestone"/>
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Milestone">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Milestone_Bot" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update farming list" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_UpdateList" name="Farming list update requested" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingListUpdateRequested</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdateList" name="Farming list updated"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Start_Task" sourceRef="StartEvent_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Task_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdateList"/>
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_UpdateList">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Update_Player" name="Player">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_Start_Task" sourceRef="StartEvent_Farming" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_Task_End" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="EndEvent_Farming"/>
      <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Farming">
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Farming_Bot" name="Farming bot">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Farming_Player" name="Player">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
      </bpmn:laneSet>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostFarm_Split" name="Choose post-farming actions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostFarm_Join" name="Post-farming actions complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Begin_CreateBot" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_CreateBot"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateBot_ChooseResources" sourceRef="Task_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_ChooseResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseResources_Priorities" sourceRef="Task_ChooseResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Priorities_Dependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_Farming" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_PostSplit" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarm_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarm_Split" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bragSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SendMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarm_Split" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">materialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarm_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendMaterials_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarm_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarm_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>

    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Main_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Begin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DefineDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostFarm_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostFarm_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Main_Bot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
